schema.help: Your own e-scooter or a shared one. Mopeds and seated scooters don't count here.
schema.text: Do you ride an e-scooter to get around at least once a week?

ar.#Do you ride an e-scooter to get around: هل تستخدم السكوتر الكهربائي للتنقل مرة واحدة على الأقل في الأسبوع؟
ar.#Your own e-scooter or a shared one. Mop: سكوترك الكهربائي الخاص أو سكوتر كهربائي مشترك. لا تُحتسب هنا الدراجات ذات المحرك الصغير ولا السكوترات ذات المقعد.

de.#Do you ride an e-scooter to get around: Fahren Sie mindestens einmal pro Woche mit dem E-Scooter, um irgendwohin zu kommen?
de.#Your own e-scooter or a shared one. Mop: Ihr eigener E-Scooter oder ein geliehener. Mopeds und Motorroller mit Sitz zählen hier nicht.

en.#Do you ride an e-scooter to get around: Do you ride an e-scooter to get around at least once a week?
en.#Your own e-scooter or a shared one. Mop: Your own e-scooter or a shared one. Mopeds and seated scooters don't count here.

fa.#Do you ride an e-scooter to get around: آیا حداقل هفته‌ای یک بار برای رفت‌وآمد از اسکوتر برقی استفاده می‌کنید؟
fa.#Your own e-scooter or a shared one. Mop: اسکوتر برقی شخصی یا اشتراکی. موتور گازی و اسکوترهای صندلی‌دار اینجا حساب نمی‌شوند.

fr.#Do you ride an e-scooter to get around: Utilisez-vous une trottinette électrique pour vous déplacer au moins une fois par semaine ?
fr.#Your own e-scooter or a shared one. Mop: La vôtre ou une en libre-service. Les cyclomoteurs et scooters à selle ne comptent pas ici.

hu.#Do you ride an e-scooter to get around: Használ elektromos rollert a közlekedéshez legalább hetente egyszer?
hu.#Your own e-scooter or a shared one. Mop: Saját vagy megosztott elektromos roller. A segédmotoros kerékpárok és az ülős robogók itt nem számítanak.

it.#Do you ride an e-scooter to get around: Vai in monopattino elettrico almeno una volta a settimana per spostarti?
it.#Your own e-scooter or a shared one. Mop: Il tuo monopattino o uno in condivisione. Motorini e scooter con sella qui non contano.

tr.#Do you ride an e-scooter to get around: Haftada en az bir kez elektrikli scooter ile yolculuk ediyor musunuz?
tr.#Your own e-scooter or a shared one. Mop: Kendi elektrikli scooter'ınız veya paylaşımlı bir elektrikli scooter. Mopedler ve oturaklı scooterlar burada sayılmaz.
